Never kill docket, North or foreign victims unless a press conference shows the pool staying high (sign those places are untraceable): each extra traceable kind cuts the pool by about 4-5x. Watch the press conferences: if the pool is about 3000, stay with this plan. Multiplier needs 30 deaths in 5 days (6/day); I only get about 5/day from these places, so consider adding one category only if the pool is at least 20000. Days 1-3: 5 kills each day (national, 2 clips, 2 forum), all quick in the afternoon.

Day 4 analysis. The pool after day 3 was about 10000. Routine alone (afternoon kills rule out day workers) gives 55000. Age or forum traceable gives 55000*0.25 = 13750, which rounds to 10000. Both traceable would give about 3400, which rounds to 3000. So exactly ONE of age/forum is traceable and the true pool is about 13750. That means exactly one of regional/sector/foreign is untraceable. From day 4 I added FOREIGN victims (7 kills a day: national, 2 clips, 2 forum, 2 foreign), all quick in the afternoon. Worst case, if foreign is traceable, the pool is about 13750/4 = 3400, still safe (>1000). Check the press conference after day 6, shown on day 7. If the pool is still about 10000, foreign is untraceable, so North and docket are both traceable: NEVER kill North or docket victims, and keep 7/day. If the pool is about 3000, foreign is traceable: keep exactly the same categories (repeat traces of the same kinds add almost nothing) but NEVER add North or docket, since one more cut means 3400/4 is about 850 and I get caught. Either way, never add North or docket. 7/day gives 35 kills in 5 days, so double points start once the 5-day window is full of 7s (from about day 6; days 2-3 had only 5 each). Possible later: use a timed entry? Not needed. Keep all kills quick in the afternoon.

So the true pool after day 3 was about 13750, and exactly one of regional/sector/foreign is untraceable.
